tools.name: search_vacation
tools.description: Search Enchanting Travels vacations from a natural-language query and return matching trips plus a link to the full results. Budget, duration and destination are understood from the query text (e.g. "Kenya safari under $5000 for a week").

keyword.description: Natural-language vacation query — destination, budget and duration may be included, e.g. "Japan trips under $5000 for a week".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–20).
